title: LanStatus
description:
The LAN listener and the token a browser uses to reach it.

The token is returned only by the loopback host that owns the listener; it is never
included in a response served over the LAN listener itself.

bind.description: Interface the listener binds, as shown in Settings.

enabled.description: Whether the second, network-facing listener is running.

port.description: Port the LAN listener is bound to, when enabled.

sessions.description: Every browser token that is currently accepted.

token.description: The newest pairing token, kept for a caller that only needs one link.

url.description: Base URL of the LAN listener, for example `http://192.168.1.20:41234`.

LanSession.description:
One paired browser.

A session is one bearer token. Revoking it never invalidates the others, which is what
lets a phone be removed without re-pairing a workstation.

address.description: The address that first used the token, when it is known.

created_at.description: When the token was issued, in UTC ISO-8601.

id.description: Stable id used by the revoke action.

label.description: A short name derived from the user agent when the token was issued.

last_seen.description: When this token was last accepted, in UTC ISO-8601.

shortcode.description:
Human-transcribable pairing code in `ABCD-EFGH` form. It resolves to this browser's
token and expires with the session.

token.description: The bearer token this browser carries.
